findings.claim: The new analyzer descriptors MsgPack019-022 are Error severity and enabled by default, but the diff does not show AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md being updated. This risks RS2000 release-tracking warnings in the analyzer build, and the rules are missing from the documented rule table. The diagnostics are only emitted for [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] users, so they do not affect existing users.

receipt_plan.detail: Check whether AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md has entries for MsgPack019-022 and whether build emits RS2000 under warnings-as-errors.

findings.claim: The contractless wire contract excludes get-only properties and readonly fields, and members are ordered alphabetically. This differs from ContractlessStandardResolver, which includes more members and uses a different order. The same type formatted through the dynamic contractless resolver and through the generated formatter would produce different bytes or lose members. This is a new opt-in feature, so existing users are not affected. The ledger says to follow the requirement (L19).

receipt_plan.detail: Serialize a class with a get-only property and a public field using ContractlessStandardResolver and the generated formatter, then compare bytes.

findings.claim: The attribute filter in GeneratorUtilities compares the display string of the attribute class against the full attribute name. It excludes formatters that carry [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] from hand-written formatter registration. Existing user formatters are unaffected, since the attribute is new.

receipt_plan.detail: Rerun generator snapshot tests to confirm that existing outputs are unchanged.
